note: Budgets per asset class, copied from docs/twin-v2/QUALITY-BAR.md section 1. Read by scripts/blender/twin/check_asset.py and scripts/twin/build-assets.mjs.
tris: most triangles allowed at LOD0, LOD1, LOD2. null means that level does not exist for the class (the asset is culled or replaced by an impostor there).

lod2Optional: the class has no LOD2 by the table, but one may be supplied up to this many triangles (the pipeline test props, so all three levels are exercised; trees, as a few large cards until P04 makes impostors, so they do not vanish from the overview).
texture: longest side in pixels that textures are resized to by the build. lodDistances: metres where LOD1 and LOD2 (or the cull) begin, at the reference view (45 degree lens, 900 px tall).
downloadMB (P02c, measured basis in docs/twin-v2/review/P02c/REPORT.md): most megabytes the built file may be, textures shared with other files not counted. Over it the build warns; it does not fail.
folder: directory under public/models/twin/ for each id prefix.
